args.title: Ironbark Tooling newsletter — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter: Ironbark Tooling's latest edition leads with "Cold-chain logistics in 2026" (https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain).
• Article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data — and most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
• Companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion, unlocked by registering with daniel.ferreira@northwind.example): pilots cut claims by a quarter.
